title: elm-cem facts bundle (Face B + Face C)
description: The canonical facts bundle emitted by elm-cem. Face B (`cem-facts.json`) carries the primitive, .d.ts-resolved CEM facts. Face C (`elm-api-facts.json`) carries the generated-Elm API projection. Both carry a provenance stamp. Face A (generated Elm source) is not a JSON artifact and is out of this schema's scope. This document is the schema for the bundle as a whole; a producer MAY emit the two faces as two files, in which case each file is the corresponding sub-object.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS bundle schema. Bumped on any breaking change to either face.

cem.description: Facts about the input manifest itself, copied verbatim from its own top-level fields.

schemaVersion.description: The custom-elements-manifest schema version the input manifest declares (its own `schemaVersion`).

duplicates.description: Declarations dropped because another declaration already claimed the same authoritative tag. Emitted so a consumer never has to re-derive a dedupe decision (and can see what was dropped) instead of silently losing an element.

aliases.description: Every literal-union type alias harvested from the package's shipped `.d.ts` tree (or from an equivalent TypeScript source root), with whether the union is CLOSED. An OPEN union (one whose members include `(string & {})` or a bare `string`) is recorded but must NOT be treated as an enum.

union.description: The alias body, whitespace-normalised, double-quoted, leading `|` dropped.

values.description: The literal members, unquoted, in declaration order. Present for both closed and open unions (for an open union these are the KNOWN members, not the whole value space).

source.description: Where the alias body came from. `dts` = a `.d.ts` literal-union alias; `const-object` = a FAST/Fluent-style `declare const X: { readonly a: "a" }` harvested into a union; `ts-source` = a non-published TypeScript source root; `config` = supplied by producer config.

file.description: Path (relative to the scanned root) of the declaring file.

components.description: One entry per unique, authoritatively-tagged custom element, sorted by `tag`.

stats.description: Producer-side counts. These exist so a consumer (or a gate) can assert the bundle did not silently degrade — e.g. `enumAttributes` collapsing to ~0 is the signature of a `@m3e/web` publish that ships no `.d.ts` at all.

faceBProvenance.description: The Face-B provenance stamp: exactly what upstream artifact these facts were read from. Replaces m3e-okf's `data/sources.json` SHA pin, cem-figma-connect's fixture version, and tailwind's declared-vs-installed @m3e/web version.

source.description: The upstream component library the CEM came from.

version.description: The RESOLVED installed version (not a range) — `2.7.0`, never `^2.5.14`.

sha.description: The upstream VCS commit the artifact corresponds to (`matraic/m3e` HEAD when generated from a clone), or null when only an npm version is known. Both are stamped so a git-SHA pin and a semver pin become comparable in one place.

manifestPath.description: Path of the manifest read, relative to the workspace root.

integrity.description: The lockfile integrity hash of the resolved package, when available.

dts.description: The TypeScript declaration root that enum unions were resolved from.

tagReconciliation.description: The result of reconciling each class declaration's jsdoc `tagName` against the authoritative `custom-element-definition` export (`customElements.define(name, Class)`). Face B is emitted POST-reconciliation, so no consumer re-implements this; the mismatch list is published so a consumer that wants to report on analyzer bugs (m3e-okf's CEM-TAG-MISMATCH) can, without parsing the CEM.

registrationTag.description: The authoritative tag from the registration export — this is what the bundle uses.

componentDir.description: First path segment under the source root, so a consumer can key the finding to a component section.

tag.description: The AUTHORITATIVE tag (registration export). Never the raw `decl.tagName`.

sourceFile.description: The module path prefixed with the package's source root, as a consumer-quotable file reference (e.g. `packages/web/src/button/ButtonElement.js`).

componentDir.description: The grouping directory (`button`, `app-bar`) — the second path segment of `modulePath`. m3e-okf groups its cards by this.

properties.description: Public, documentable class FIELDS. Includes those that back an attribute (`attribute` names it) so a consumer can filter either way rather than re-deriving the attribute/field split.

name.description: The content-attribute name, verbatim (kebab as declared).

fieldName.description: The backing IDL property name the CEM declares, when any.

default.description: The CEM's declared default, VERBATIM including its surrounding quotes (`"\"filled\""`). Consumers that want the bare value strip the quotes themselves; keeping it verbatim is what lets m3e-okf compare a README default against the manifest without re-reading the manifest.

kind.description: The post-resolution classification. `none` = the CEM declares no `type` at all. `other` = a function type or an array shape. An OPEN union (see `enum.open`) classifies as `string`, deliberately: any frame name is legal for `LinkTarget`, so it is not a closed value space.

enum.description: Present whenever the resolved type contributes literal members — for a CLOSED union (`kind: "enum"`) and also for an OPEN one (`kind: "string"`, `open: true`). Two consumers need the two readings: the matcher must not treat an open union as an enum axis; m3e-okf's cards want the documented member list either way.

values.description: The literal members, unquoted/parsed, in DECLARATION order (the `.d.ts` alias order, or the inline union's order).

open.description: True when the union admits values outside `values` (`(string & {})`, a bare `string`, or an unresolved identifier member).

faceBTypeInfo.description: An attribute/property/event type in every form a consumer needs: as the manifest declared it, as resolved, and where the resolution came from.

raw.description: `type.text` exactly as the manifest declared it (`"ButtonVariant"`, `"boolean"`, `"LinkTarget"`).

resolved.description: The type after alias inlining and after preferring the analyzer's expanded `parsedType.text` where present. Equal to `raw` when nothing resolved.

parsed.description: The analyzer's own `parsedType.text`, when the manifest carries one — kept distinct from `resolved` so a consumer can tell an analyzer expansion from a producer-side `.d.ts` inline.

aliasName.description: The TypeScript alias the raw text named, when resolution fired (`ButtonVariant`). Docs provenance; also the join key into `faceB.aliases`.

source.description: Which reading produced `resolved`. A consumer that wants to report on resolution quality reads this instead of guessing from the shape of the string.

attribute.description: The content attribute this field backs, when it backs one. Null/absent means JS-only.

name.description: The slot name VERBATIM — the empty string for the default slot. A consumer that wants to render `(default)` does so itself.
Events with no resolvable name are DROPPED by the producer, so a consumer never has to filter a nameless entry.
The custom-property name including the leading `--`.

faceC.title: elm-api-facts.json — the generated-Elm API projection
faceC.description: What the producer EXPOSED, handed over directly. Every name here is emitted by elm-cem, not re-measured from its output.

surfaceKeys.description: The surface keys this bundle populates, i.e. exactly the keys that appear in some component's `surfaces`.

defaultSurface.description: The surface key a consumer should use when none is configured.

facets.description: The facet table: for each surface key, the Cem.Facts facet constructor and the CALL SHAPE of its entry. Emitted as data (not hardcoded in a consumer) because the shape is a property of what the generator emitted.

finalizer.description: The function that closes a pipeline form (`toElement`), or null for the list forms.

components.description: Keyed by CEM tag, so a consumer joins Face B and Face C on the tag with no name derivation. Group VARIANTS appear as their own entries under their real tags.

faceCProvenance.description: The Face-C provenance stamp. Supersedes cem-figma-connect's `elmM3eCommit` + `elmM3eSentinel`: staleness is now a stamp mismatch, not a re-parse of generated Elm.

producer.description: The generator that emitted Face A and therefore knows Face C.

commit.description: The elm-cem generation commit. Null only when generated outside a VCS checkout.

brand.description: The brand Face A was generated INTO (elm-m3e).

lib.description: The brand's Elm root namespace, e.g. `M3e`.

commit.description: The brand checkout commit at generation time — the replacement for `elmM3eCommit`.

configFiles.description: The `--config-from` inputs (in merge order) that shaped the projection. A Face-C fact can change from config alone, so the config identity belongs in the stamp.

source.description: The same upstream stamp Face B carries, repeated so Face C is self-describing when read alone.

cemTag.description: The authoritative CEM tag (same value as the map key, and as `faceB.components[].tag`).

module.description: The component's Standard/top module, fully qualified (`M3e.Button`) — `Cem.Facts.Fact.module_`. For a home-grouped member this is the HOME module, which is why it cannot be derived from the tag.

memberPrefix.description: The alias prefix a home-grouped member's types carry inside its home module (`""` for a single-member home). elm-cem's `memberRef.prefix`.

tokenModule.description: The module exposing enum value tokens (`M3e.Values`). Null when the brand mints no unions (elm-cem omits the module entirely in that case).

actionModule.description: The module exposing the action constructors (`M3e.Action`), or null when the brand has no action roster.

usesAction.description: Whether the component's record shape carries an `action` field — `Cem.Facts.Fact.usesAction`.

actionMap.description: Action attribute name → action constructor name. `Cem.Facts.Fact.actionMap`.

setters.description: Attribute/slot-independent setter map: CEM attribute name → the exposed Elm setter name, or null when the producer did not expose one. Null is a first-class value: a consumer must refuse to emit rather than guess.

setterArgTypes.description: Setter name → the Elm argument kind, so a consumer formats literals correctly (a `float` renders bare `70`, never `"70"`). Projected from elm-cem's `Attr.AttrType`.

pipeSetters.description: Attribute or slot name → the PIPELINE setter name (`variant` → `withVariant`, `icon` → `withIcon`, and the `…Slot`-suffixed form when the plain name would collide). Required to emit the `build`/pipeline form at all; no consumer reads it today because no consumer can currently reach that surface. elm-cem computes these as `attrPipeNames`/`slotPipeNameOf`, including the collision rule.

eventHandlers.description: CEM event name → the exposed Elm handler name (`input` → `onInput`), after the brand's prefix-strip and collision resolution (`Brand.resolvedEventHandlers`). Kept separate from `setters` because an event handler is not a settable attribute — a distinction the re-measuring builder has to reconstruct with an `/^on[A-Z]/` regex.

slotSetters.description: The per-component content-setter names for named slots (`Cem.Facts.Fact.slotRewrites`' setter side). A name here is a slot function, NOT a settable attribute.

slotSetterMap.description: Raw CEM slot name → the Elm content-setter name — the full `slotRewrites` pairing, so a consumer can go from a slot in Face B to its setter without re-casing.

slotUpgrades.description: Component-specific upgrades of a generic barrel slot setter — `Cem.Facts.Fact.slotUpgrades`' setter side.

slotKinds.description: Raw slot name → the child kinds the slot accepts. Absent/empty means unconstrained.

requiredAttrs.description: HTML attribute names the record/pipeline forms REQUIRE — they become mandatory record fields, so a consumer emitting those forms must supply them.

group.description: Set when this entry is a member of a variant-group module (e.g. the `circular`/`linear` members of `M3e.Progress`). Null for an ordinary component.

groupConstructors.description: On a group PARENT entry: its member constructor names. Empty for an ordinary component.

surfaces.description: Surface key → the addressable entry point at that surface. Only keys the producer actually emitted appear.

aliasName.description: The generated Elm type-alias name for this enum, and (via Face B's `type.aliasName`) its upstream TypeScript provenance.

key.description: A canonical join key (lowercased, non-alphanumerics stripped) so a CEM value `extra-small` and the Elm `extraSmall` match without either side re-canonicalising.

token.description: The fully-qualified token reference (`M3e.Values.extraSmall`), or null when the producer did not expose it.

raw.description: The HTML attribute value this token renders to — elm-cem's `Brand.tokenValues`. Usually identical to the CEM literal, but a config `attrTypes` MAP override can make them differ, and only the producer knows.

module.description: The module that actually holds the entry — NOT derived from a path convention. For the Html facet of the current emitter this is the single per-brand `M3e.Html`; for Standard/Record/Build it is the component (or home) module.

entry.description: The exposed entry function at this surface: `view` (Standard), `el` (Record), `build` (Build seed), or the component constructor (`button`, in `M3e.Html`).

finalizer.description: The function that closes the pipeline form. For the current emitter this is `toElement` (re-exported per component from `M3e.Build`) — NOT `build`, which is the seed.
